## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_28_courier_the_bulb_walk",
  "text": "We go tomorrow for the bulbs. The Electrician drew me a picture. A rectangle with two lines. That is a ballast. A tube with two pins. That is the bulb. I have the picture on the back of the Surgeon's list hand, which is fading, which I re-wrote this morning because the Surgeon's list is the hand I write on and the bulb guide is the other hand. I am running out of hands. The Teacher would say that is a metaphor. The Teacher is not here. The Teacher is in the classroom teaching the water cycle to the ones who are here. I am here and I am going. The agri depot is 12 kilometres. The first time we went for the potassium and the fleece and the lime. This time we go for the light. The light is the thing that grows the food. The food is the thing that feeds the people. The people are the 47. The 47 are the reason. The reason is the thing I carry. I carry it in the containers and in the list and in the picture and in the hands that are running out of space. The Hunter says I talk too much in my head. He is right. He says the walk is the walk. I say the walk is the reason. He says same thing. I do not think it is the same thing. I think the walk is the walk and the reason is the reason and the reason is why the walk is worth it. He says that is the same thing said twice. He is 40 and I am 22 and he has walked more than me. I will listen. I will walk. I will carry the picture and the containers and the reason. The reason is the bulbs. The bulbs are the light. The light is the food. The food is the 47. Tomorrow.",

  "author_name": "The Courier",
  "author_id": "the_courier",

}
```

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The group plans to go twelve kilometres to the agricultural depot for bulbs. The Courier carries a drawn ballast picture, containers, and the Surgeon’s list written on his hand; the depot was visited before for potassium, fleece, and lime. He links the bulbs and food to the forty-seven people. The Hunter says the walk and its reason are the same. Do not add the expedition’s outcome. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Human center

The source voice is The Courier. The Courier’s inner argument is earnest and overfull, while the Hunter’s reply reduces the walk to its immediate task. Preserve their disagreement without making one voice correct for the other. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.
